title: Get Cultured
style: afrobeats pop fusion, 122 BPM, talking drum percussion, bright brass, joyful energy, multicultural education theme, call and response hook, playful confident male vocal, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
You want to know how to say hello in Swahili?
You want to know what they eat in Napoli?
You want to move like they move in Rio?
You want to feel what they feel in Seoul? — let's go

[CALL AND RESPONSE CHORUS]
Get cultured! (Get cultured!)
Learn before you land
Get cultured! (Get cultured!)
Culture in your hand
Get cultured! (Get cultured!)
Every continent's calling
Get cultured! (Get cultured!)
PLUGGED — can't stop falling

[VERSE 2]
Hospitality starts with knowing
Where your guest is from and growing
Say their greeting in their language
Watch the whole room change — advantage

Japanese bow — Thai wai
Arabic welcome — Irish slainte
Ten cultures — ten hellos
PLUGGED teaches — watch it grow

[BRIDGE]
Culture isn't learned — it's felt
Culture isn't forced — it's dealt
One lesson — one day — one word
One connection — that's the world

[FINAL CHORUS]
Get cultured — every morning
Get cultured — no ignoring
Get cultured — PLUGGED is calling
Get cultured — always falling — forward

[OUTRO]
Get cultured.
Every day.
One word at a time.
